newsitem.title: PERU: Peru says 1996 oil output falls 2.9 pct vs 1995.
newsitem.headline: Peru says 1996 oil output falls 2.9 pct vs 1995.

text.p: Peru produced an average of 118,270 barrels per day (bpd) of crude oil in 1996, down 2.9 percent from 121,762 bpd last year, state hydrocarbons regulatory body Perupetro said Friday.
A statement from Perupetro added that total production in 1996 was 43.91 million barrels.
Natural gas production in 1996 was an average 23.96 million cubic feet per day, Perupetro said without giving a comparative figure. Total natural gas output last year was 9.77 billion cubic feet.
U.S.-based firms Occidental Petroleum Corp, Petro- Tech S.A., Argentina's Pluspetrol and state oil company Petroperu S.A. account for more than 90 percent of Peru's total oil output.
